---
title: "External Reading Map"
---

This page maps your situation to the matching chapter in a verified external
textbook. Your situation is defined by `stat_goal` and `design`, using the
same controlled vocabulary as the prompt-library schema in
`prompts/_schema.yaml`. Each link carries its own licence. The table below is
generated automatically from the `links` field of each prompt-library entry
(`prompts/entries/*.yaml`), so the mapping stays maintained in one place. For
the full content of an entry, see the [Prompt library](../prompts/index.qmd).

This page is English-only. The source textbooks are all in English.
bradduthie/stats is linked only, never excerpted. Its NonCommercial licence
is incompatible with this site's CC BY-SA licence, so mixing its text in would
leave the site's licensing unclear.
